messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: streaming-service (eu-west-1) p99 latency crossed 1500ms for 2 consecutive mins. SLO (p99 < 800ms) degraded. Affected route: /v1/stream/generate. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/streams/alerts/6954321000

devon_oncall: ack. I'm on it. pinging infra + ml.

tyler_sre: @devon seen the spike. Any recent deploys or precision changes?

anika_prod: pushed a precision-toggle experiment to a small fleet 8m ago — enabled int8-fast for streaming models in eu-west to test cost/latency tradeoffs. Not full rollout.

maria_support: we just got a customer message about streaming sessions stalling and partial outputs for a subset of requests. Customer says p95 responses frozen around 15-30s.

squad-lead-ml: @anika can you confirm the exact toggle and which model variant?

anika_prod: flipped precision-profile "int8-safety-v2" on canary nodes (node groups sg-canary-3). Only for model: redwood-llama-13b-stream. Rolling back now if needed.

devon_oncall: checking traces and kv-cache heatmaps. Looks like dequant path is causing sporadic stalls when sequence length > 1024. p99 tokens/sec drops and backend queue piles.

tyler_sre: logs show repeated dequant timeouts at kernel boundary: ``ERROR kernel: dequantize_chunk timeout=1200ms src=kv_cache``. Also seeing spikes in GPU compute wait.

devon_oncall: running quick query on metrics: ``sum(rate(stream_latency_bucket{le=\"1.5\"}[1m]))`` yields big drop. Attaching ascii graph:
```
   p99
   |         *       *
   |       *   * * *  
   |   * *           *
   +-----------------> time
```

anika_prod: I'm initiating immediate rollback on the canary group to previous profile. Will broadcast when rollback completes.

maria_support: CS already queued customer update: "We're investigating increased latency for streamed responses in EU — working on mitigations and will follow up in 15m."

devon_oncall: for mitigation: 1) rollback precision toggle on canary 2) temporarily route heavy long-context traffic to fallback model (redwood-llama-13b-fp16) 3) enable bypass-kv-dequant flag on proxy to avoid in-request dequant when sequence len > 1024. I'll start 1+2 now.

tyler_sre: ready to update routing rules. Devon, want me to flip fallback traffic for sessions with "long_context=true"?

devon_oncall: yes, flip that rule. Also add 5m backoff to re-queues.

anika_prod: rollback command issued: ``/deploy rollback precision-profile int8-safety-v2 --group sg-canary-3``. Patch applied to 6 nodes. Monitoring for recovery.

incident-bot: Deploy rollback job 3421 started by anika_prod. ETA 45s.

maria_support: customer notified: "We've reverted a recent precision experiment in your region and routed long-context sessions to a fallback model. Expect improvements shortly."
devon_oncall: routing change applied. Verified 200 sessions moved to fp16 fallback. Watch p95/p99 now.

tyler_sre: after routing + rollback, p95 dropped from 1.2s to 420ms and p99 trending down from 2.1s to 780ms in the last 90s. Still a small tail bump at 880ms.

devon_oncall: confirming: tail stalls mostly from requests that hit an older KV cache shard where cleanup tasks were queued. Triggering async KV flush on those shards.

anika_prod: note: the int8 path still left a small legacy cfg on 2 canary nodes. I'm force-stopping the service on those nodes and re-provisioning.

maria_support: CS update: "Latency largely recovered; a small fraction of streaming sessions might see intermittent drops. We're monitoring and will let you know once fully stabilized."

squad-lead-ml: good job. Next steps for postmortem: 1) root cause — why int8-safety-v2 dequant path interacts badly with long-context KV shards; 2) regression test to catch dequant timeout with seq_len>1024; 3) fail-safe: don't enable precision toggle for streaming route unless kv_shard_version >= X.

devon_oncall: agreed. I'll collect traces and attach a kernel-level flame for the incident. Tyler, can you capture exact GPU wait stacks for the 3 affected hosts?

tyler_sre: on it. grabbing `nvidia-smi dmon` and perf traces now. Will upload to S3: s3://incidents/6954321000/gpu-traces.tar.gz

anika_prod: adding checklist item: validation harness needs synthetic long-context stream tests hitting dequant path under load. Also add canary gating: require <200ms dequant median for 30m before any precision rollout.

devon_oncall: incident-bot, mark incident as "mitigated". We'll keep monitoring for 30m before close.

incident-bot: Incident 6954321000 status updated: MITIGATED by devon_oncall. Paging closed.

maria_support: CS follow-up queued for 30m post-mitigation.

anika_prod: I'll open RFC for precision rollout safety checks and a hotfix to make dequant path async-safe (priority P0 - release in 48h).

squad-lead-ml: assign owners and schedule a 1hr postmortem tomorrow. Add customer impact summary and timeline.

devon_oncall: logs & traces saved: s3://incidents/6954321000/ (latency-csv, crash-logs, perf). Will paste quick TL;DR in the postmortem doc.

maria_support: thanks team. I'll update CS once 30m window passes.

tyler_sre: leaving a quick note: mitigate decision order important — routing + rollback before KV flush reduced customer impact. Keep that order for future runbooks.

devon_oncall: ends. I'll watch dashboards for the next hour and close thread when stable."
